title: THE CURTAINS OF CONTROL BEHIND TRUMP’S DESK

sense.text:
Jeremiah wrote in the time of Babylon, but he is making reference to Babylon the Great, and Babylon the Great is America. “Babylon hath been a golden cup in the Lord’s hand, that made all the earth drunken”: America gave its wine, its philosophy, to all the nations and made them drunk. Drunk to the point that America takes their resources and gives them lies, gives them a whole new culture against their own culture, destroys their economy and makes them forever dependent on this beast.

America is very small in land on this planet and is only 5% of the world’s population, yet one out of every four prisoners in the world is in America’s jails. That is a gangster society, and its education is there to indoctrinate you into accepting this as the way. That is not a call to go against the government with sticks and guns. You are no match for a man who knows how to kill and get glorified for it, who can go to church with blood on his hands, get baptized, come up a saint and build a church in your neighborhood. Let him be.

“The nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.” The nations have been made drunk by America’s foreign policy, something the people in America are meant to know nothing about. The nations are angry, because foreign policy destroyed the economy of all these places: Ukraine, the Arabs, every place people are coming into this country from. They are coming because they are mad.

Behind the curtains they talk about bringing 30,000 Ukrainians into Chicago to whiten it out, and the same was done in Cleveland: let crime in by benign neglect until the people sell their properties for nothing and leave, and then Esau buys it cheap. So don’t look at the deportation of the Northern Kingdom and think that is it. They will do the Southern Kingdom the same way.

But the people behind the curtains are controlled by the Most High, and they can do nothing he does not allow. Israel needs a swift kick in the ass to get its business together, and that is what the Most High is doing. He gives you one president to put you to sleep and another to hit you with heat, and it keeps Israel swinging back and forth, never focusing on what we need to be doing as the Israelites.

“Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed”: suddenly fallen because of those caterpillars and their taunting proverb. This land is not yours; you destroyed the lands where we come from; now we have come over here to get some revenge. That is what is on their mind, and they are just waiting on orders.

“Take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.” Here comes the preacher getting up with a Bible he is not even reading, trying to heal Babylon the Great. The phones of these negro preachers are being rung: say hallelujah to the people, put them to sleep, get them thinking the Most High is going to pour balm all over this place to calm it down. No. The Most High is the one bringing evil on the city.

“If so be she may be healed” is the Most High making a mockery: if you think you can save it, try. That is for the politicians and the preachers who always think they can somehow make things work. This does not go against being at peace with all men, if it be possible. That is not being a punk. If it is possible, we want peace; if it is not possible, we have to go somewhere else.

“We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed”: the preachers would have healed Babylon, but the Lord said you are not going to heal this. It has a green light to go down, into perdition, and you cannot stop it. All of this is in God’s plan. The Most High is using the people behind the curtains to put things out the way he wants them to go, and meanwhile Trump, Biden and Kamala Harris are putting you to sleep. Had Kamala won, she would not have controlled anything either, just as Trump controls nothing. The ones sitting in that chair are not running the company; they are the representative.

Abortion is health care, health care is a human right, they say. Black people ain’t even got no damn rights. What the hell are you talking about?

“Forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country”: come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins; come out and be ye separate, saith the Lord; gather yourselves together, O nation not desired. All those scriptures are rolled up in this one statement. Learn to put the scriptures together in your mind, even when they are not being read. Get your studies up, because the times are getting ready to be hellish.

“For her judgment reacheth unto heaven”: can these preachers stop it? If her judgment has reached unto the Lord, nothing is going to stop Babylon the Great from being destroyed.

precepts.why:
Our people, and especially the Latino community, voted for this man expecting help, expecting something from the devil, from the whole system. The scripture is plain: “As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.”

We have watched for a nation that could not save us. That is why you don’t vote for them. Never trust your enemy. Their whole goal is to keep themselves on top and let us remain at the bottom.

What we have to do is come together under the law, statutes and commandments of God, unify and build for our own. God made us the best of the earth. We don’t need them to save us, they are not going to, and they don’t want to. Use this world but don’t abuse it, and don’t put your trust in this system.

This is the scripture of the caterpillars, read to show why the nations are mad and why Babylon falls suddenly.

“Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon”: the standard is this Bible. It is going to be set on the walls of Babylon the Great. They don’t want to hear it, but they are going to hear it. There is no other standard; this is what stands, and everything else falls. “Make the watch strong, set up the watchmen”: the watchmen are the prophets. “Prepare the ambushes”: the enemies of this Bible and of the children of Israel are preparing to destroy God’s people. That is what you see in the deportations and in all these so-called rights being taken away. You never really had them. You can have them as long as you don’t know what to do with them.

All the scriptures, videos, pictures and books are dots of vital information. You can have a house full of books and the white man doesn’t care. The problem comes when you know how to connect the dots and form the real picture, which they teach you nowhere: not in school, not in church, not in politics, music or movies. When you can see the real picture, you are in trouble, and they make moves to get rid of you.

“For the Lord hath both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babylon.” The prophecy is already written. The Most High has already destroyed this place.

“O thou that dwellest upon many waters”: who is the thou? America, Babylon the Great, with its battleships that dwell upon many waters. Not Russia, not the rest of the nations. “Abundant in treasures”: abundant in everybody else’s treasures, because she robbed all the nations. “Thine end is come”: you can’t stop it, but here comes a negro preacher thinking he is going to save it. “And the measure of thy covetousness”: the measure of the mistreating, the robbing, the raping and pillaging of my people has come up to me, God said.

“The Lord of hosts hath sworn by himself”: he asked nobody else; he swore by his own name. “Surely I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillers.” Not maybe: surely. These caterpillars are the terrorists, those who came from robbed homes, destroyed economies, rubble and bombed-out cities where children were wiped out by our bombs. They are coming over here by the thousands and the borders let them in, while Trump talks about getting rid of the Israelites, who have done nothing but be the victim of everything.

Why caterpillars? Because caterpillars are parasites. A crab apple tree in North Carolina got a great web in its branches, and the tree began to die: the caterpillars were sucking the nutrients out of it until it became brittle and had to be taken away. They rot it from the inside out. That is what God will fill Babylon the Great with.

“And they shall lift up a shout against thee”: these same caterpillars shall lift up a shout against Babylon the Great. They always throw out one shout, but they are not all Arabs. What the shout is, is written in Habakkuk 2.

sense.text:
This is the shout Jeremiah said the caterpillars would lift up against Babylon, and the verses before it show who it is against. “Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him”: that is Babylon the Great, not just Trump, all of them. His soul is his spirit, the demonic spirit God put in them. You can’t get it out; that is their nature. The snake bit you and you wonder why. His soul is not upright because he is a demon, a devil, satanic.

“But the just shall live by his faith”: we are supposed to live by the faith of the Most High. That is how we are supposed to be operating.

“Because he transgresseth by wine”: Esau sins by his wine. The wine is his murdering philosophy, the pride that says I cannot be taken down: I am the kick-ass master, I am the robber, I am the lyncher, I am the henchman, I am the murderer, and you can’t do nothing. He stands on that. Manifest destiny: move out the way. This ain’t your land, he says, and knocks you out of the way. Might makes right. Obadiah says the same: thy pride hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock. You that dwelt in the caves: that is why they are called Caucasians. God has their number.

He sins by the power in his mind: I have the weapons, I have the tanks, I go to the moon, I kill, I am God. You heard Biden the other day: we don’t care how society didn’t deal with them; we just have to be pragmatists and get rid of the problem, even though we created it. That is the arrogance that says, leave it in the Bible that Christ is black, because black people won’t repeat it. In his mind, ain’t no nigger going to tell me that, because a noose is waiting on the one who does, a psychological noose, like what they did to Kyrie Irving. Show your family that Christ has hair like wool and feet like brass burned in a furnace and they say you have been around them Israelites. You can say Christ is black here and there, but if you start connecting the dots, that we are the Israelites, and waking up your brothers and sisters, now you have problems.

He transgresses by knowing that this is his time, his demon rulership, his power to be Satan. That is what Alexander understood from Daniel: this is my time. And when he started ruling, evils were multiplied on the earth.

“He is a proud man, neither keepeth at home”: he doesn’t stay at home. Gad and Reuben were here already. He destroyed them, and now he has them looking for papers to prove they belong in their own homeland, and if they can’t find the paperwork, they are sent away to Guantanamo Bay. Then he brought us over here on slave ships and robbed us thoroughly, robbed our minds like an empty bottle. He raped the black woman every day with impunity, sent her husband out to walk while it happened, and she still had to build up his courage, knowing he could not protect her. We never got any therapy for that trauma.

That was not enough. He went overseas and robbed the people of their resources and minerals, with embargoes and sanctions, and now they come to America, not to join hands but to do other things. He made us the dry bones in the valley, and it took the Lord to wake us up; that is what Ezekiel 37 is about. We are the product of being awoken after that destruction, and we are bold as a lion.

“Who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied”: you can’t deal with a beast with an appetite that cannot be satisfied. His desire as hell is to take everybody down. Everything he touches brings death and hell to the people; that is the pale horse. When he creates havoc in those lands, the children there say we have to go over there and get revenge, and that is why they are here. That is the shout.

That appetite for destruction and power is because they are rolling on borrowed time. They have no time to waste; they must satisfy every nuance of the demons in them. Israel has the promise of everlasting life. Once their clock is over, it is over; God has set their bounds that they cannot pass.

“But gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people”: come on into my borders, he says; 30,000 Ukrainians come in and get rights the people who have been here never got. He heapeth unto him all people because everybody is trying to be like him. The Northern Kingdom brothers are crying because they are being made to leave this country. He says you have to be like me to be somebody; forget about going back to your own. And we base ourselves on their imagery: a black woman with gold hair looking like a bumblebee.

“Shall not all these take up a parable against him”: all these nations that have been thoroughly robbed, these caterpillars. He opened up the borders, the caterpillars came in, and they are not here to join in. They are mad about what was done that made them leave where they were, and they are here on a different agenda.

“And a taunting proverb against him”: this is the shout of Jeremiah 51. “Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his!” America does not belong to them. Every place Esau has gone, he took it from the people who were there. He is not native anywhere. His only home is Mount Seir.

precepts.why:
God has set people’s bounds that they cannot go beyond, and Esau knows his boundaries. How could he label a section of history the Middle Ages if he had no idea where the end was? He knows he is on borrowed time, and so he says: I am going to be Satan and the devil, manifest destiny, and don’t you niggers get in my way, because I will kill. I am a sociopath, I have no feelings, I am a demon and meant to be a demon until I can’t be no more. That is his nature; that is why he bit you.

“Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.” Who can make the white man a saint? Who can make Esau righteous? Baptizing him, bringing him into church, saying prayers around him, marrying him: that will not change nothing. What God considered unclean, you cannot clean up. Not one of you can.

“Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee”: his days are determined by God, and every second of Esau’s months is with the Most High. That is why they research everything: they want to know how much time they have got. Like the empires: Babylon, then Persia and the Medes, the Greeks and the Romans, and out of Rome came an eighth head, America, at the Renaissance, and it shall go into perdition.

“Thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass”: God has appointed Esau’s boundaries. The Most High set up the rulership, and Esau did a diligent search to find what God in the Bible has to say about his own rulership. When Alexander saw the priests coming with the Bible, he saw it was him, and he was glad: I am in the prophecy to kill, murder, rob and destroy. And he went wild.

Esau does not want to lose that. And the same spirit the Most High put on him, not to want to give it up, is what will kill him when he fights against the Lord. The great red dragon is these red people that you call white. They are the ones that will fight against Christ and the angels and be destroyed in one hour.

When Christ came into the country of the Gergesenes, “there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.” Two men with demons in them, coming out of the graveyard, so fierce no man could pass. Demons like that can take eight brothers to hold one man down.

“And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God?” The demons recognized Christ. And the demonic rulers of this setup recognize the spirit of Christ in you. They know that as you wake up, their time is coming to an end. They measure time by looking at your progress: the more of you that wake up, the more they know their time is ending.

That ain’t Trump. That is the demons behind the shadows, the wickedness in high places. It is called high places because it is up out of your eyesight, the way the people behind the curtain cannot be seen. That is where they orchestrate all this evil, with their witchcraft rituals to keep the demons in power.

“Art thou come hither to torment us before the time?” Did you come here to interrupt our rule, to shut us down before our time to shut down is at hand? The demons knew it was their time, and Esau knows this is his time. I brought you here to rape and rob and pillage you, he says, but now you are waking up and breaking away from my control, and the more I see you wake up, the more I know I am about to lose everything. So he takes sociopathic actions. He has no time to worry about your feelings, or to feel sorry, or for US Aid.

sense.text:
John was banished to the island of Patmos for teaching the Bible: you are not allowed to connect the dots and wake your people up, so we will banish you, the way people are sent to Guantanamo Bay. While he was on that island, Christ showed him visions of the end time, and kept showing him this red beast. The beast represents Babylon the Great.

“Wherefore didst thou marvel?” Why are you marveling, John? Don’t worry, I am going to take care of you. “I will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which hath the seven heads and ten horns.” The beast is all the seven heads, and the woman on them is America, Babylon the Great. The question was about the woman. She has the seven heads in her background because they supported her, and the ten horns support her too: NATO, the EU.

“The beast that thou sawest was”: it was in your vision, John, because I showed it to you. “And is not”: it is not in your time yet, because America did not exist when John was on that island. “And shall ascend out of the bottomless pit”: the bottomless pit is Europe. That is why she keepeth not at home: there are no resources there, so she gets them from everywhere else. “And go into perdition”: this beast shall go into destruction. God has set his bounds that he cannot pass.

“And they that dwell on the earth shall wonder”: walking up and down this place asking where Babylon the Great is, looking in some damn Iraq, and your black ass is standing in it. “Whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world”: Babylon the Great as a nation, as a physical place, was not written in the lineup of the nations, because it was not in existence. The land was here, because Gad and Reuben were here, but it was not made into America until the dregs came over and took it, and then wrote the Constitution to say you ain’t a part of my society. That is why it was a mystery.

“When they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is”: when they see it, the beast that was in your vision, John, and is not in your time yet, but yet it is coming. When it comes, the people on Babylon the Great will behold it and not even realize they are in it.

That is how this ties to the curtains: the people who run this whole setup are what is running this country. It is not Trump. The people behind the curtains are what we are reading about.

“The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sitteth”: mountains mean rulership. The woman is Babylon the Great, America, and she rests on the seven heads: Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia and Great Britain. She was born out of Britain in the war of independence. That is why they say, I am American, I am British, French, German, Italian, but I am going back home to Greece. That lets you know where they came from. And they call the Bible a fairy tale. This is history; somebody needs to take a big Bible and slap the hell out of whoever talks that craziness.

“And there are seven kings: five are fallen”: Greece, Spain, France, Germany and Russia. “And one is”: Rome, the one John was in. Rome was ruling, and that is why Christ was being taxed in Matthew. “And the other is not yet come”: Great Britain. “And when he cometh, he must continue a short space”: when Great Britain comes, it completes the seven, and it had control of all of this for a short space.

“And the beast that was, and is not”: in your vision, John, but not in your time yet. “Even he is the eighth”: that is the woman. “And is of the seven”: the eighth head came out of the seven; it broke off from Britain in the war of independence, and that is how they established Babylon the Great. “And goeth into perdition”: this eighth head, Babylon the Great, shall go into destruction, and that is where we are now.

That is how they know the times. They named the Middle Ages because they know we are in the time when this is going to be destroyed.

precepts.why:
The mystery of the woman: “And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT”. Mystery means where is it, who is it, because it was not in existence at that time. Even now the people are here in Babylon the Great beholding the beast and never know that this is it. Who is the wicked, who is the mystery of iniquity, who is the man of sin? Christianity makes you think it is everybody else except the one bringing you Christianity, the so-called white man. He is the devil himself, hiding in the Bible.

Babylon the Great is great confusion. You can’t get a better picture of confusion than the twelve tribes of Israel in this country, the Negroes and the Hispanics, who can’t even figure out how to work together.

“THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS”: she went throughout all the nations and lay with them, to make them drink her philosophy, her policies, her business transactions, the international banks. She is banging all the nations and making them drunk to follow her. That is what Lady Liberty in the harbor, with the seven points on her head, is about.

“AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH”: the greatest abominations are done right here. That is why the caterpillars are here: they saw what happened when America came and lay down with them and messed up their economy and their culture, and they said we need to get back at her.

sense.text:
“Alexander son of Philip, the Macedonian, who came out of the land of Chettiim, had smitten Darius king of the Persians and Medes, that he reigned in his stead”: he took over Persia. The Persians were not Israelites, but they were dark-skinned people. How are you going to claim their antiquity when that is not you? That is how sick these people are.

“The first over Greece”: Alexander was the first king. That is what the brothers showed him in the eighth chapter of Daniel when they met him in the field, and he said, that must be me: I am getting ready to fulfill prophecy.

“And made many wars, and won many strong holds, and slew the kings of the earth”: because of his pride, because he knew he was satanic on earth. When Antiochus came up he said I am the power of God on earth, and that came right out of Alexander. That is their pragmatic, sociopathic thinking: slay everybody, the hell with your babies. Look at the slaughter when they went to Santo Domingo, the island of Hispaniola, hacking our brothers and sisters to pieces, hanging them up and burning them alive, throttling their throats so they could not scream, and loving it. That is the kind of snakes you are dealing with.

“And went through to the ends of the earth, and took spoils of many nations, insomuch that the earth was quiet before him”: the earth was quiet because when they heard he was coming they were afraid. This man moved with choler.

“Whereupon he was exalted, and his heart was lifted up”: exalted in his spirit, nobody can touch me. Josephus says the same of the Greeks: they grew potent, knowing they had this power behind them, the power to do all kinds of murder. And they claimed to themselves the glory of antiquity, the ancient glory of the Egyptians, the Babylonians and the Persians, black people who were all before them, and named the nations with Greek names.

“Kings, who became tributaries unto him”: tributaries means servants. Don’t just read these lines and think that was all. There was a lot of war, pillaging, murder, rape and robbery going on to make the nations subject to them and pay them tribute.
“He fell sick, and perceived that he should die”: he was so damn wicked that the Most High said it is time to put your lights out.

“And parted his kingdom among them, while he was yet alive”: he divided his kingdom among his four generals, Lysimachus, Ptolemy, Cassander and Seleucus. They set up the same government over all the nations, so the same lies taught here are taught everywhere, according to the edict Alexander set up from what he read in the books he had his people collect from everywhere.

“And after his death they all put crowns upon themselves; so did their sons after them many years”: a long line of how they move, their posterity. “And evils were multiplied in the earth”: when they started ruling, evil became number one. Folly is set in great dignity; the people mourn when the wicked are in power; the earth is given into the hand of the wicked. When that wickedness started, the forming of Babylon the Great began, and Trump is just another piece of that long legacy of evils.
“And there came out of them a wicked root, Antiochus surnamed Epiphanes”: Bishop Nathanyel went through the legacy and the destruction of this king the week before.

precepts.why:
This had to be the very scripture the brothers showed Alexander. “Behold, an he goat came from the west”: the he goat is Alexander. “On the face of the whole earth, and touched not the ground”: he was lifted up with pride. He knew he had the power of Satan behind him; he was in Bible prophecy. You know the confidence that gives you, to know you are fulfilling scripture. Nothing weighs on him: the hell with them damn ugly-ass babies, chop them up. That is how he thinks. That is how they move, and that is how we will move when the Most High sets us up.

“And the goat had a notable horn between his eyes”: somebody who was going to be prominent in history. “And he came to the ram that had two horns”: the ram is Persia, Darius to be exact. “And ran unto him in the fury of his power.”

“And he was moved with choler against him.” Choler means anger, irascibility; the old dictionaries say anger was supposed to come from an abundance of bile. It means anger, wrath, irritation. Alexander looked at Darius like an irritant, a fly buzzing in your ear that you don’t ask nicely to leave; you want to hit it and break the table. That is how these people see us: some of them call black people obsolete farm machinery, no more use for you. We are not their farm machinery. We are their daddies, their new lords, the ones that are going to whip their ass into submission, and then put their ass to death when it is over.

Choler is irritation of the passions: he was passionate about destroying Darius. Easily irritated, inclined to anger, excited by anger: he loves to be angry. That is the choler this man moved with against Darius.

“And smote the ram, and brake his two horns”: he broke his power. “And there was no power in the ram to stand before him”: the ram could not stand against the Greeks, because they had the power of Satan behind them, and Darius knew he was going to be next. That is a heavy thing to have on your mind going to war. Like soldiers with war music playing in their helmets, it is blind rage: anything that moves, you slaughter it.

“But he cast him down to the ground, and stamped upon him”: he stamped his philosophy on him. “And there was none that could deliver the ram out of his hand”: there was none that could deliver Darius and the Persians out of the hands of the Greeks.

“And the rough goat is the king of Grecia”: the rough goat is the he goat, the one the brothers showed Alexander, the king of Greece, the first over Greece as Maccabees says. “And the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king”: that is Alexander himself. It names him. So when he met the brothers in the field and they showed him this, he said, I perceive that is me.

sense.text:
From Alexander that wicked root was established, and when that wickedness started, the forming of Babylon the Great began, all the way up to now. Trump is just another piece of the long legacy of evils. Don’t be pointing your finger at him; that evil started way back then.

“And in the latter time of their kingdom”: the same kingdom, because after Greece came Rome. Their kingdom means the whole white world, their rulership from Alexander the Great on: the latter time of so-called white dominance. Rome was overthrown in 193 AD by the Jews, and the Jews are black: the Israelites. That began what they call the Dark Ages, from 193 AD up to 1453 and the battle at Constantinople. The Moors of Spain from 711 AD were black people too; the paintings and castles were black rulership.

“When the transgressors are come to the full”: it is the same thing as Babylon will not be healed, the measure of their covetousness has reached up, and God is about to judge them.

“A king of fierce countenance”: people think this is Trump. It is talking about America, the whole American system, Babylon the Great, and the people who run it are the people behind the curtain, the wickedness in high places.

“And understanding dark sentences”: knowing how to keep the people’s minds suspended in stupidity, in Christmas and bunny rabbits laying eggs and Valentine’s Day, all that confusion to keep you jacked up and broke and trusting an oppressor. That is what the dumb television programs, the stupid music and the dumb movies do. Babylon the Great. It is a damn shame for people to be this damn dumb in these days.

precepts.why:
“And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him”: this beast is America, and the first beast is Rome. “And causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast”: the image of Cesare Borgia came from Rome, the image people run around calling Jesus Christ. They made you worship that, because that image came from Rome. That was the Renaissance, the rebirth of what was thrown down in 193 AD.

“Whose deadly wound was healed”: how did Rome get a deadly wound? The blacks took it over, under Septimius. That is what the movie Gladiator was about, us ruling; that is why they put black people in it. They put the dots there, hoping the people won’t connect them, and when people like us connect them, all of a sudden we are a hate group.

“And he doeth great wonders, so that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men”: America dropped the atomic bombs on Nagasaki and Hiroshima in 1945, in front of everybody, so that nobody would mess with this beast. “And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles”: nobody had ever seen fire come down like that before. “Which he had power to do in the sight of the beast”: in the sight of all the red nations watching.

“That they should make an image to the beast”: they went back to Rome and got Cesare Borgia and made that image, painted by Leonardo da Vinci and Michelangelo in 1492, when they took over: the Borgia family. “Which had the wound by a sword, and did live”: Rome was wounded, yet it lived, because it was reborn as America, the eighth head that came out of the seven.

“And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death”: one of those seven heads that was wounded was Rome, in 193 AD. “And his deadly wound was healed”: healed in the Renaissance, which means the rebirth of the head that was deadly wounded. That is the history.

sense.text:
This was read for Dr. Martin Luther King’s last speech, on April 3rd, the day before he was assassinated. He said if he lived in China or Russia or any totalitarian country he could understand the injunctions, but he was in America and expected them to be true to what they said on paper. He realized it did not pertain to us. Esau sat there monitoring him, not clapping, taking notes. Anybody who dares to speak truth in this system is marked for death, and he spoke with courage in the face of it.

He said he had been to the mountaintop. That means he went behind the curtains. He knows we are the Israelites; he connected the dots, and he was talking in code. “The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sitteth”: if the seven heads are seven mountains and he has been to the mountaintop, he is telling you he knows what is up there.

Then he said we as a people will get to the promised land. Not everybody: we as a people. The promised land is for the Israelites. That is what he told you, and the white man sitting in the front caught it. He felt death coming, the same way Malcolm X felt it when he sent Earl Grant away to make the phone call and spared his life.
